notes: For BoRacer, preserve the recognizable burgundy-and-white shutters, dark black awnings, stepped dormers, hipped tiled roof, central balcony with flags, and waterside terrace.
The AI views are illustrative and not rigorously consistent orthographic projections. Reconcile features against original photographs when producing a 3D model.
All 1024-square views are placed within transparent padding; the original scene backgrounds inside their photographs are opaque.
Texture panels are reference details, not tested seamless/tiling materials; the SVG embeds the line-art raster, and is not vector path geometry.
